name: MedAgentBench
intro: MedAgentBench是一个广泛的评估套件，旨在评测大型语言模型在医疗记录环境中的智能体能力。它包含300个由医生编写的临床任务和100名患者的真实数据，在一个符合FHIR标准的交互式环境中进行，以推动模型在复杂医疗任务中的规划和工具利用能力。
build_method: 医生任务策展、去标识EHR抽取、FHIR环境构建
task_type: 医疗Agent, 工具调用, EHR交互
eval_feature: FHIR交互环境, 查询与动作任务, 规则评分
task_type_en: Medical agent, tool use, EHR interaction
build_method_en: Physician task curation, deidentified EHR extraction, FHIR environment construction
eval_feature_en: FHIR environment, query and action tasks, rule-based grading
intro_en: MedAgentBench is a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to assess large language models' agent capabilities in medical record environments. It includes 300 clinician-written clinical tasks and real data from 100 patients, conducted within an interactive environment compliant with FHIR standards, aiming to advance models' planning and tool-use abilities in complex medical tasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.14654 and the official stanfordmlgroup/MedAgentBench code. The diagram preserves two internal-medicine physicians, 300 tasks across ten specific and seven broad categories, inpatient and outpatient scope, a 100-patient STARR cohort anchored on morning sodium labs, five years of labs/vitals/procedures/diagnoses/medications, synthetic MRNs and Faker demographics, the exact 785,207 FHIR-resource count, HAPI FHIR JPA with persistent H2 and Docker packaging, nine official GET/POST functions plus FINISH, 150 query and 150 action tasks, manual reference solutions for query grading, rule-based POST-payload checks for actions, and Overall/Query/Action Success Rate.
